title: Five days of classical painting with Jan-Ove Tuv
intro: Paint from a live model every morning. Paint the hills and coast of Mols in the afternoon. For beginners and experienced painters.
video_intro: Jan-Ove shows how to mix colour with the Apelles palette. Watch it to see how he teaches.

details.title: The days
details.body:
- 10–13: Painting from the live model: light, shadow and colour mixing
- 13–16: Break: lunch, rest, a swim
- 16–: Optional painting outdoors in the hills, by the coast or in the garden

On rainy days the atelier stays open.

details.title: Your teacher
details.body:
Jan-Ove Tuv is a Norwegian painter and longtime student of Odd Nerdrum. He paints and teaches in the classical, old-master tradition from his studio on the south coast of Norway, and hosts the podcast The Cave of Apelles.

He teaches in English and Norwegian.

details.title: Where to stay
details.body:
Lodging is not included, which keeps the price down. Choose what suits you:

- Bring a tent and camp in the Rødegaard garden for a small nightly fee
- A room at Rødegaard / Jordens Sang: kontakt@jordenssang.dk
- Molsgaarden B&B, Kildevej 26, Knebel

details.title: Food
details.body: There is a small kitchen in the atelier where you can cook. There are no shops in Knebel. Groceries are in Vrinners or Ebeltoft, about 20 minutes by bus.

details.title: Getting there
details.body:
Rødegaard, Karlshøjvej 5, 8420 Knebel, Denmark. About 45 minutes by car from Aarhus.

From Norway, the Larvik–Hirtshals ferry is the easiest route.

details.title: What to bring
details.body:
- Your own oil painting materials. You get the full list when you reserve.
- A canvas for the model painting
- An easel or pochade box for painting outdoors

details.title: Reserving and paying
details.body:
Write to Lasse to reserve a place. You get payment details, the materials list and practical information in reply.

Questions first? Write to lassetopbjerg@gmail.com or call +45 31 17 75 06.
